top_apps.description_excerpt:
Welcome to Meow Sort: Color Puzzle Master, a cozy logic leisure game full of adorable furry kittens!
Your goal is to group all felines with identical shades on separate shelves. Only move top kittens, match same tones to finish each round.
✨ Game Highlights
• Simple single-tap control, friendly for new players
• Hundreds of handcrafted stages, difficulty rises gently
• 100% offline accessible, play on commute or rest time
• No countdown timer, enjoy gameplay at your own pace
• Lovely cartoon art and soothing background audio
• Suitable for kids, teens and adults to train logical thinking
No complicated rules, just arrange cute cats and release daily stress. Download now and unlock endless relaxing sorting fun!
